description: React component for organization setup in onboarding wizard, managing organization name input, team creation/update, and UI transitions.

methods.name: setApiCallError
methods.description: Sets the teamApiError ref to TeamApiError indicating an API error occurred.

methods.name: updateTeamNameFromOrgName
methods.description: Updates the current team with the organization name entered by the user.

methods.name: createTeamFromOrgName
methods.description: Creates a new team with the organization name entered by the user.

methods.name: handleOnChange
methods.description: Handles change in organization name input field.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Handles proceeding to the next step, creating or updating team based on current state.
